title: Live TMF921 suite is intermittent: test reads a server report before it settles
description: Seen in Phase 4 plan 04-08: four runs of TMF921_LIVE=1 gave 1 failed/15 passed, 2 failed/15 passed. The failing test reads a server report before the server has settled it; wait for the report that carries the probe post, not just a higher report count. Phase 4 did not touch it.

title: Live proof of a success or failure verdict from POST /context/request with telemetry flowing
description: Plan 03-09 ran POST /context/request live with no telemetry and the bound intents absent from the TMF921 server, so only inconclusive verdicts were seen (current: 'intent server unavailable'; past: 'missing observation' per metric). A success or failure verdict through the route has only been shown by unit tests. Needs: an intent that exists and is ACTIVE on the TMF921 server with a binding in the graph (see contextbroker-tey.11) and the telemetry simulator running. Requires an operator go-ahead (creates an intent and a binding).

title: Graph holds bindings for three intents that no longer exist on the TMF921 server
description: Found in plan 02-09 live run (.planning/phases/02-bitemporal-goal-and-topology-history/02-09-PLAN.md). The persistent Fuseki store holds 15 :ServiceBinding for intents 43c5b2d1-e8d4-4617-99d0-fbaee822084a, 588b93c6-579e-42b1-9525-58b7f6372cf7 and 982b6a0e-e741-44b1-a9aa-c9f3cca59eab, but the TMF921 server (56 intents listed) has none of them (GET returns 404). Historical assess (as_of/known_at) reads only the graph so the Phase 2 checks passed, but a current-instant assess for these intents has no intent to check. Decide: re-create demo intents and re-bind, or remove the stale bindings. Not a Phase 2 defect.

title: bind_intent --correct cannot target an already closed goal from the command line
description: The intent carries only the current goal, so --correct can only supersede the open goal or placement fluent. The guarded_insert(closed_by=...) update already supports correcting a closed fluent. A later phase could add a way to name the valid time to correct. Noted in 02-04 and in design/bitemporal-fluents.md known limits.

title: Parity test: remove its own old-shape fixture when a run is interrupted
description: tests/test_fuseki_parity.py loads an old-shape binding and link fixture for the migration 002 check. If the run stops between loading it and the migration, the leftover makes the next run on the same throwaway container fail the foreign-data guard until the container is recreated. Option: delete only the fixture's own subjects (IRIs carrying the run suffix) in a finalizer. Found in plan 02-08 (.planning/phases/02-bitemporal-goal-and-topology-history/02-08-SUMMARY.md).

title: Require a token for /docs and /openapi.json, or turn them off
description: Phase 1 verification warning: /docs and /openapi.json answer 200 without a token and list every route. They sit outside the /context prefix. The API is published on 0.0.0.0:8080. Decide whether to disable them or require a token.
notes: Phase 3 plan 03-07: /openapi.json now also publishes the POST /context/request schemas, purposes, classes and relationship types (none secret; examples use made-up names). Still public; bead stays open.

title: API container cannot reach tmf921-server across compose projects
description: Found in Phase 1 plan 01-09 Task 1 (.planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-09-PLAN.md). contextbroker-api (project contextbroker) starts on contextbroker_default only; tmf921-server lives on contextbroker-arch_default, so /health reports tmf921 not answering (503) until 'docker network connect contextbroker-arch_default contextbroker-api' is run by hand (lost on recreate). Fix options: join the external network in docker-compose.yml, or run tmf921-server from this compose file (profile tmf921).

comments.author: Brad
comments.text: Plan 02-09 live run: manual 'docker network connect contextbroker-arch_default contextbroker-api' was still needed after both compose up (twice, including after compose down). Not fixed.

title: Per-endpoint Fuseki access control so the broker's read credential cannot update
description: Plan 01-06 (T-01-22, accepted): Fuseki main has one realm, so the API and LodLive proxy hold a credential that can also update the network graph. Add per-endpoint access control (query-only user for readers). Related plan: .planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-06-PLAN.md

title: ABox directory: load only files written by bind_intent
description: The ABox is generated per intent, so a static allow-list does not fit; a licensed .ttl copied into ontologies/abox/ would still load via ingestion.load_ontologies. Restrict to files written by bind_intent. Follow-up from phase 1 plan 02 task 3 (T-01-09, accepted). Plan: .planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-02-PLAN.md
close_reason: ABox directory loads only bind_intent-marked files or the static demo file; commit 21c1ce2

title: OKF knowledge and lexical/vector retrieval
description: Portable curated knowledge (OKF) and lexical/vector retrieval (spec 4.4, 4.5) are not built. Largest new components, least urgent while the demo is an intent-assurance loop. Gap analysis section 4 item 5.

title: Requirement wording says push 'older than or equal' is refused; code allows equal time with equal value
description: Phase 4 verification advisory. Align STATE-01 / ROADMAP wording and design/durable-state.md with the rule: refused when older, or equal time with a different value.

title: Phase 4 plan 04-08 expected a repeat push of an equal observation to be refused, but equal time with equal value is allowed by design
description: Plan text in .planning/phases/04-durable-situation-state/04-08-PLAN.md is wrong; the code and an existing unit test allow it. Fix the plan wording only if the plan is reused.

title: TMF921 assess reason says "intent server unavailable" when the intent does not exist on the server
description: Found live in Phase 3 plan 03-09: POST /context/request (assurance, current instant) for an intent id that the TMF921 server answers 404 for gives verdict inconclusive with the single reason 'intent server unavailable' (intent_management/tmf921_source.py, get_intent except Exception branch). The server is up; the intent is missing. The verdict is correct (inconclusive), only the fixed reason string misleads. Related: contextbroker-tey.11 (stale bindings for intents that no longer exist). Needs a distinct fixed string for a missing intent; keep 'never echo server text'.

title: Phase 1 review info items IN-01..IN-07
description: Throttle 401 logs; enforce password charset; /health ties to optional TMF921 profile; image hardening (pin base, .dockerignore .env.* and ontologies/abox, read_only, cap_drop, no-new-privileges); unused imports and shadowed assess_intent in main.py; broad except reports local bugs as intent server unavailable; ingestion edge cases (post_metrics timeout, traceback, ABox containment, joiner imports simulator). Source: Phase 1 code review, .planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-REVIEW.md

title: API image carries untracked runtime files (.gsd, telemetry.log, telemetry.pid, stop_context.sh)
description: Found in plan 01-09 Task 1 image check: 'ls -A /app' lists .gsd/, telemetry.log (0 bytes), telemetry.pid and stop_context.sh. None are secrets and none are on the plan's forbidden list (.beads .planning scripts design CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md *.pem), but .dockerignore should exclude .gsd/, telemetry.* and stop_context.sh.
